script.quote: [p.35:] The feedback in this case is information about the presence or absence of the object signal. The control action initiated by a computer system is to reverse the direction of scan immediately when the object signal is lost. It sweeps past the "object signal" until it has lost it and then reverses its direction, returning to the object signal.

note: Step 7 speculative fixture (derivation A): every expect and until is derived by hand from the 37-wire topology and the p.35 rule (reverse the scan immediately when the object signal is lost), not printed; the printed fixture C2/V-EXP21 covers the light 6 flashes, the search sweep and the oscillation as contact changes. No erratum changes a wire (ER-39 is prose: light 6, not light 3, signals in search mode), so the wires are as printed. Topology: + reaches 2G, 2N, 3K, 4H, 5H, 6H and D1; - reaches 2K, 3N, 6E and the indicator-lamp ends 2C-5C. Slide switch 6 set 2 (6V on the wiper net with light 6) feeds relay 6 coil (6F/6U) only when LEFT. Relay 6 N.O. (6G) starts relay 5, which latches 5H-5G-5F through light 3 and ind 5 (5E); on loss of the signal relay 6 N.C. (6H-6J-5L) and relay 5 set 2 (5K) put + on N_X (2J/3H/4F/5K) as a one-shot: relay 4 (through ind 4) puts + on 5E and drops relay 5. Relays 2 and 3 are a toggle stepped by that pulse: relay 2 sets on it, relay 3 follows when it ends; next pulse relay 2 resets (3H-3G puts + on 2E), relay 3 follows when it ends. Motor: relays 2/3 out = D17 +, D18 - (toward increasing numbers, the DECISIONS 2026-10-13 [likely] polarity ruling); both in = D17 -, D18 +; mixed = both RUN terminals on one rail, stopped. Script choices, not printed: object signal D1, then moved to D9 by cord 37 (M+#1/D9#1) at the third reversal, so the move happens in the reverse state; switch 6 thrown LEFT at c9. Checks assert relay states at the tick an until resolves on a relay contact, and only where the topology forces the order. Dial c1/c9 at a relay 6 pull-in relies on relay 6 operating inside one contact dwell. Not asserted: the overshoot (how far the dial runs past the signal before reversing; it rests on the invented coasts O-R5); lamp states while a lamp is in a coil path (lights 1, 2, 3 and ind lamps 2-5 in the reverse state and during the pulse) or warming or cooling (light 6 at a relay 6 pull-in); relay 4 in the reverse state, where N_X joins 2E through 3H-3G and relay 4 sees a sneak current through relay 2 coil (by hand about 12 mA against its 17 mA drop-out). If relay 4 held there, 4G would keep + on 5E, relay 5 could not latch and the dial would run on past the signal; a failure at script[14] points there.
